current_stage_goal: Evolve executable Xeno while every go co-develops the typed Entry Fabric and reusable HCU/XCU computational substrate toward an EntityOS cognitive computer.
transition_laws: Xeno is the current go starting point and must not be discarded for a parallel rewrite.
Every go advances or explicitly assesses XCU/Entry Fabric alongside normal Xeno work.
New primitives should be reusable across multiple Xeno modes.
Zero trends toward typed cognitive ingress/admission rather than persistent persona.
Entity trends toward causal/state/authority coherence rather than anthropomorphic identity.
HCU/XCU cells trend toward request-scoped logical function slots rather than persistent mini-agents.
Permanent duplicate reality is not required; bounded WM_TEST and selective NESTED_SIM are active experimental modes.
Global J-Space remains an empirically instrumented coupling hypothesis; local J-Space claims require model-specific causal evidence.
Hyperposition preserves unresolved alternatives; majority vote cannot mint truth.
Logical module count cannot be reported as simultaneous model/decode count.
Real effects remain deterministic, journaled and gated.
current_frontier: Build Xeno Entry Fabric plus a reusable 10-cell scheduler/state/interconnect baseline; progressively separate XRAM/XPU/XCU responsibilities so the same substrate can support COGSIM10, WM_TEST, NESTED_SIM and measured scale-out without rewriting authority boundaries.
go_contract: Every go refreshes current main and newest owner authority; starts from strongest current Xeno implementation; performs hypothesis/counterhypothesis/discriminator reasoning; advances the highest-information nonduplicate Xeno blocker/capability AND XCU/Entry co-development; favors cross-mode reusable primitives; preserves exact canonical-state/provenance/generation/effect fences; and records bounded evidence. Full world/nested simulation and ~600 logical-module scale are selective research targets, never unmeasured runtime claims.
legacy_scope: Frank/ClayVerse remain historical donor evidence. Mini Entity/MicroEntity paths and mini_* identifiers are compatibility/provenance aliases for the Xeno bootstrap until exact migration.
